## 中国军情 · 10 items

China's defense establishment is on the offensive diplomatically, rebutting accusations of espionage and warning against Japan's remilitarization. The G7 statement on the East and South China Seas and Taiwan drew a sharp response. At the same time, China is asserting leadership in military AI governance and demonstrating long-range strike credibility with a think tank report claiming capability to hit Australia.

- **Japan under fire:** China’s Ministry of National Defense labeled Japan’s acceleration of remilitarization a ‘powder keg’ for the Asia-Pacific ([联合早报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTFBQNXEyMGw0dUVUZDRxWXhSRngyWW01WWs3YUlSWVRmR1VXUVREd3V5OFI0SEhCQ1BYMGpDeXVhNkl2N3JrV2sxTkZEQzZNbVdlMXItSlhfc2k1WmhrU2tfWHIyUVVYbGtLakE), [中华网军事](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE5NbXI3ODhieWpVUGc5bFl1dWlfX0ltNzhaRXhQd1VjS1VIVFFyZlRqQmc5aVUtamdnQWVyY0VkUnNnZFFmaEs5cGJLTDE0b1MxSHZZbmEzRmhZejlseFhGcWlhd2VBUVdBNjlMM2dYdzc)). This aligns with the R6000 tiltrotor drone entering full flight testing, enhancing China’s power projection ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/chinas-big-r6000-tiltrotor-drone-has-entered-full-flight-testing)).
- **US blacklist and BYD response:** The US added some Chinese firms to the “China Military Company List,” prompting a response from the Ministry of Commerce ([财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag)). China is simultaneously projecting military capability and diplomatic pushback. ## 海军与印太 · 7 items

Naval and Indo-Pacific developments are heavily focused on the US legislative push to support allies and restrict foreign shipbuilding. The Senate Armed Services Committee authorized $1.5 billion for Taiwan and the Philippines while limiting the Navy Secretary’s ability to buy foreign-built warships. Meanwhile, Ukraine received a minehunter from the Netherlands, and the US is expanding Basa Air Base in the Philippines to host more drones and fighters.

- **US Congress reshapes Indo-Pacific security aid:** The SASC bill authorizes $1.5B for security assistance to Taiwan and the Philippines, including a war reserve stockpile and a South China Sea crisis management strategy ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/16/sasc-bill-authorizes-1-5b-for-security-aid-for-taiwan-the-philippines)). This reorganizes existing efforts into a joint defense framework.
- **Restrictions on foreign-built warships:** Both the Senate and House defense bills propose restrictions on the Trump administration’s push to buy foreign-built warships, limiting the Navy Secretary’s ability to rename ships ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/16/senate-house-defense-bills-propose-restrictions-on-u-s-warships-built-in-foreign-yards-legislation-limits-navy-secretarys-ability-to-rename-ships)). This signals bipartisan concern over sovereign shipbuilding capacity.
- **Philippine air base expansion:** A U.S.-funded project is expanding drone and fighter capacity at Basa Air Base, enhancing monitoring of the South China Sea and defensive support for Manila ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/16/u-s-funded-project-expanding-drone-and-fighter-capacity-at-philippine-air-base)). Commercial satellite imagery confirms clearing at the northwest end of the base.
- **Naval technology transfers:** Ukraine received the ex-Dutch Alkmaar-class minehunter, now named Henichesk, boosting its mine countermeasure capability ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/ukraine-receives-ex-dutch-alkmaar-class-minehunter-henichesk)). The Netherlands also signed a contract with Naval Group for F21 heavyweight torpedoes for its Orka-class submarines ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/dutch-mod-and-naval-group-ink-f21-torpedo-procurement-contract/)).
- **Autonomous systems progress:** The GAO report to Congress found that the Navy needs to address leadership and organizational challenges to meet urgent needs for robotic autonomous systems ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/16/gao-report-to-congress-on-the-navys-robotic-autonomous-systems)). HII delivered the first REMUS 130 UUV to a U.S. ally, marking a milestone in underwater autonomy ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/hii-delivers-first-of-the-newest-remus-variant-130/)).

The congressional moves to restrict foreign shipbuilding while ramping up aid to Taiwan and the Philippines indicate a strategic shift toward strengthening domestic industrial base and allied self-defense. Watch for the final NDAA language and its impact on future US naval procurement.
